author: Czco
body:
Application
Age: 13
Timezone: GBP
Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes/No: Yes (But prefer discord)
Do you have access to Skype? Yes/No: Yes (same with before prefer discord)
Do you have access to a recording software? Yes/No: Yes

CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION

Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

I have a lot of experience being a staff member on other servers, i ran one or two servers in the past with one being relatively  successful. In running these servers i have become great at coding and using my abilities to help any player or staff member to the best of my ability. I have had a few other moderator positions on small servers and one big which has helped me to use my authority to help the good and stop the bad.

What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness is my lack of ability of at pvp ( this may not affect my moderating)

Love the game and so I love to play which allows me to enable others to enjoy playing too. I am interested in improving both the play side of Minecraft and the development side.

How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I believe i can help the staff team in one place which is getting online the second we get reports and beginning to sort them out. I think its horrible to be in a game and then some random dude starts flying around hacking and just spoiling it for the others, so i feel that the second we get a report we can get right on the point and allow our players to have a great time on the server.

What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

A leader needs to be serious not joking around and messing but a leader can never do anything on their own, a leader needs others or the whole team will fall and be a mess, a leader needs to be ready to help at any moment in time to stop problems and help our other players that are need our help. 

I do consider myself a leader but i would never consider myself as a leader if i was talking to an admin or higher. i do not think i should be boss of everyone just people that are rule breaking and those who need me.

What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

My experience and contribution in game will help me and i think stands out amongst others, by this i mean i hate to see people getting bullied or people saying they would kill others or stupid things like that. I find excessive language is another thing that needs to be settled down with on Avicus it really has died down from a few years ago. I have had many other successful jobs on other servers before this that i gave up time to spend here. i feel a connection between me and the community and feel i could make it even better in some small places that may need help or an act of kindness or a dispute that needs solving.

What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

My skills to talk to players that speak different languages and ability to help when i say help i mean that i will try my hardest to get them what they want ( that they are allowed ) i am on the website and forums a lot of the time if the need link or any other method of getting them there help.

So yes i do believe i have these abilities as they are what i have used in the past and has worked out as quite a success.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)? 

18 - 19 hours of game play a week and sometimes a bit more. i sped 1 hour of that on hypixle some on another small server and the rest here on the avicus.


CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

If this where to happen to me i would try to find out who they where and do a ip ban on there account if this didn't work i would always be ready to ban them and stop them from messing up others game play.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

I would always agree with what the leaders say and follow there role, i would make no comment to his face just a suggestion to the leaders on how to hustle him out or calm him down. what i mean is to get leaders or myself to talk to him in detail about what he's doing and how he should probably stop.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realise that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

If this would have happened i would easily state that i was a eye witness and have other players who where online to tell higher staff members that he or she was definitely hacking or cheating. If we could not proof any more and admins say he/she is un ban i will closely watch him for any other signs of cheating.

You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would suggest to them not to post random pictures or text that is not of any value or help to the group. 


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I would contact the seiner staff member and explain why I disagree but ask them to explain the full details of the situation so that i might understand their decision.


CRITERIA 3: OTHER
NOTE: This is a new criteria and these questions are less to do with right/wrong answer and more to do with us getting to know you. Please answer these honestly. There is no right or wrong answer.


What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

It would mean a lot i spend a lot of time online and i really love the community i find to get this position would mean quite a lot to me and i will spend a lot more time online with the players and staff trying to make there avicus life span a lot better.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

I am very passionate about the Avicus network as i have been there for a long time watch my online friends and players grow up with me and as i saw the sight on the forums i thought i had to apply to make it more interesting for me and better for other. i have known two admins for a very long time i don't know if they would remember me so i won't mention any names.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

I speak 3 other languages other then english 

A small bit of french 

Quite a lot of Spanish

And a fare amount of Swedish  




Do you have anything else to add to your application?

No, not really. i wouldn't like to ruin my chances of being a moderator
